operations.description: Evaluate change point score of every series point
operations.summary: Detect change point for the entire series
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] change point detect [PATH] timeseries change point detect [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] change detect point request response

operations.description: This operation generates a model using an entire series, each point is detected with the same model. With this method, points before and after a certain point are used to determine whether it is an anomaly. The entire detection can give user an overall status of the time series.
operations.summary: Detect anomalies for the entire series in batch.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] entire detect [PATH] timeseries entire detect [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] detect entire request response

operations.description: This operation generates a model using points before the latest one. With this method, only historical points are used to determine whether the target point is an anomaly. The latest point detecting operation matches the scenario of real-time monitoring of business metrics.
operations.summary: Detect anomaly status of the latest point in time series.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] last detect [PATH] timeseries last detect [PARAMS]  [SCHEMA] detect last request response
